payload.reason: The evidence provides specific suggestions for improving the proposed memory-augmented architectures, including reducing computational complexity and parameter count, and exploring new architectures for better performance.

claims.text: Future improvements for memory-augmented architectures include simplifying the model to increase computational speed and reduce parameters, making them more practical for dialogue systems.
Combining memory module architectures with pointer softmax networks could enhance the ability to store and retrieve specific words from previous utterances.
Optimizing the training process and addressing the segmentation of input utterances could improve the efficiency of the NTM-LM architecture.
